name: patient_context
description: Retrieve structured patient metadata including demographics, medical conditions, allergies, medications, and visit history. Automatically filtered to the requesting clinic for security. Use this to get patient background before reviewing clinical documents.

list_patients.description: If true, returns paginated list of all patients for the clinic instead of single patient lookup. Defaults to false if not provided

limit.description: Number of patients to return in list (defaults to 20 if not provided, maximum 100). Only used when list_patients=true

last_evaluated_key.description: Pagination token from previous response to get next page. Only used when list_patients=true

request_hour.description: Current hour of the day (0-23) in the clinic's local timezone. Required for business hours policy enforcement. Use the current_time tool to determine this value.

name: clinic_config
description: Retrieve clinic-specific configuration including specialty, available services, operating hours, and provider list. Use this to understand clinic capabilities and context when answering questions about services or scheduling.

clinic_id.description: Specific clinic identifier (optional - defaults to requesting user's clinic)
